The second path connects Voretigene neparvovec to the Androgen receptor, which is a target of Afimoxifene, and Afimoxifene is also linked to the Protein kinase C beta type. These findings indicate that Voretigene neparvovec could influence the activity of the Protein kinase C beta type through different molecular mechanisms, possibly via the S100-A2 and Androgen receptor pathways. The evidence is consistent with the possibility of a broader biological relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain and requires further investigation.
